head: 7 new design apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These design apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Graphics & Design charts this week, from AltoPaint: Oil & Gouache to FoldTales: Duo Wallpapers.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store charts this week
means: If you're looking for something new in design, these are small apps people are buying right now.
todo: Open each app's App Store page to check the price, in-app purchases and what it needs before you download.

list.name: AltoPaint: Oil & Gouache
list.what: A pocket paint set with twelve pigments that mix like real paint, and no undo.

list.name: Google Flow
list.what: Google's AI studio for making and editing images and videos on your phone.

list.name: Vectora
list.what: A vector drawing app for fingers or Apple Pencil, with no subscription.

list.name: Tracery: AR Trace & Draw
list.what: Lays a photo over real paper so you can trace it with a pencil.

list.name: FormWright 3D
list.what: 3D modeling, sculpting, painting and animation on iPad and iPhone.

list.name: Icon Goodies
list.what: Saves original, full-quality App Store artwork for mockups and mood boards.

list.name: FoldTales: Duo Wallpapers
list.what: Wallpaper art for the iPhone Duo with a second scene to discover inside.
